NOT_SENT.description: Watchdog has not yet sent any resume command.

SUBMISSION_ATTEMPTED.description: Watchdog issued CDP send command or keystrokes, but has not yet confirmed DOM change.

MESSAGE_OBSERVED.description: Resume message was confirmed present in conversation history, but assistant has not started.

TURN_STARTED.description: Confirmed assistant turn start (Stop button active, assistant article generated).

TURN_ACTIVE.description: Conversation is currently executing a turn.

FAILED.description: Submission failed with definitive unrecoverable error.

A_before_send.window: Crash occurred before send command was executed.

B_after_send_before_record.window: Crash occurred immediately after send command was executed before watchdog state was updated.
B_after_send_before_record.recovery_strategy: Check conversation history for matching resume signature before attempting resend.

C_after_user_msg_appears.window: User message is visible in conversation DOM, assistant has not generated yet.
C_after_user_msg_appears.recovery_strategy: Wait for turn start; do not send duplicate prompt.

D_after_assistant_generation_starts.window: Assistant generation is active (Stop button visible).
D_after_assistant_generation_starts.recovery_strategy: Mark TURN_ACTIVE / RUNNING; do not send duplicate prompt.
